arithmetic.binary64_conversion_evidence: Each case preserves original decimal strings plus float.hex() and exact numerator/denominator for every converted numerical input.
arithmetic.input_interpretation: Each original decimal string is converted once to Python binary64; mpmath receives the exact rational value represented by that binary64 float.
arithmetic.input_rational_preservation_check: mp.mpf(binary64_float) was checked for equality with mp.mpf(float.as_integer_ratio numerator)/denominator at 70 decimal digits.
arithmetic.quadrature: mpmath adaptive quadrature split at every piecewise-linear gradient knot
arithmetic.root: monotone bracketed bisection over the knot interval inside the observable detector horizon
arithmetic.status_classification_tolerance: No binary64 rounding tolerance is applied to classify the acquisition endpoint; exact converted input values determine whether detector time is at or before T.

RetentionParameters: S2 optional for linear; required for quadratic and neue-kuss
input_contract.censoring_rule: If zeta_limit <= 0 or the integral through zeta_limit is below column dead time, return right_censored with retention_time_min and zeta_elution_min null. Preserve detector horizon and column fraction reached there; do not integrate to acquisition_duration_min as if it were zeta time.
input_contract.detector_horizon_rule: For detector limit T, solve only through zeta_limit = T - column_dead_time - post_column_volume_ml/flow_rate_ml_min.
input_contract.endpoint_rule: A root at zeta_limit, whose detector time equals acquisition_duration_min on binary64 inputs, is an elution at the inclusive endpoint.
input_contract.expected_numeric_serialization: Oracle numeric outputs are decimal strings preserving 70-digit precision; compare package float64 fields against these values using the stated tolerances.
input_contract.gradient_interpolation: Piecewise-linear in time; knots begin at 0 and include the exact acquisition-duration endpoint.
input_contract.post_column_rule: post_column_volume_ml / flow_rate_ml_min shifts detector time and shortens observable zeta horizon; it does not change the column root when that root remains observable.
input_contract.root_monotonicity_rule: Do not assume k(phi) is monotone. With k>0, only the cumulative integral of 1/k must be strictly increasing.

checks.observed_error: duration, flow rate, column length, and effective area must be positive
gradient times must be strictly increasing
gradient must begin at time zero and include acquisition-duration endpoint
neue-kuss denominator must remain positive on the full gradient

nonclaims: No fresh optimizer or fitting run was performed.
This is not raw-signal or peak-width parity with the upstream source-grid simulator.
Pre-injection, gradient dwell, peak width, dispersion, and Gaussian/grid masking are excluded.
No native Measure or upstream simulator/model code is imported or executed by this reviewed oracle.
Decimal strings are preserved as source inputs, but the numerical oracle evaluates their IEEE-754 binary64 conversions exactly; decimal intent is not substituted after conversion.
scope: Ideal continuous profile evaluated on the exact binary64 values obtained from preserved decimal inputs: solve integral_0^z 1/k(phi(s)) ds = L*A/(Q*1e-6), then report detector time z+t0+post/Q.
